title: Instagram carousel — Premier IA low-time light jet
hook: Low time. Big cabin for the class. Fresh Check 3.
body:
Some light jets require compromise. This 2005 Premier IA offers a different experience.

With approximately 2,835 hours total time, this aircraft is exceptionally low time for the type. It features Pro Line 21 with IFIS, TAP Blue engine coverage, and a recently completed Check 3. The Premier IA also offers one of the widest cabin cross sections in the light jet class, delivering noticeable comfort from the moment you step aboard.

Well equipped, well maintained, and ready for its next owner. Swipe through and contact us for the full specifications.
